custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'red button' area. In AI images, functional details like buttons often fail to have proper mechanical depth or bezels. Also, scrutinize the steam holes: do they look like punched metal/plastic or just dark pixels? If the topology auditor finds the holes are not connected through the object, flag as a severe artifact.
